annotations.title: Vault depositors: who holds the capital, with what is known

description: Who holds the capital in the vaults we cover, by four lenses: how long the position has been held (new under 30 days, settling 30 to under 90, 90 or more, age not known), complete exits followed by entry elsewhere, how many covered vaults the holder uses, and how much it placed in covered vaults (not its total wealth); agent-linked and other addresses apart. With vault: one vault, with its holder book time and coverage ("not recorded" where absent) and whether it can be ranked. QUOTE statements.ageCoverage WITH ANY AGE SHARE: the age is often known for a small part of the value, and the unknown part is never zero or long-term. Every share is of tracked value (usd) or of tracked positions (addresses), never of people; agent-linked is a registry match, not proof software deposited. "No matching complete exit" holds only within statements.noMatchingExit.coveredFrom..coveredTo. FREE; the largest holders’ profiles past five need a plan.

limit.description: Without vault: vaults returned, default 50, at most 200.

vault.description: A vault slug or id. Omit for all vaults together.

name: vault_depositors

all.description: Without vault: usd, addresses (positions), lens (class → usd, addresses), byWho (agent, other), flightProneUsd, stickyUsd.

at.description: When the holder profiles were built.

evidence.description: Without vault: lookThrough (grossUsd: all.usd counts capital one vault places in another in both layers; economicUsd: removed once along edges proven on chain, cycles left in both; doubleCountedUsd; ultimateHoldersUnknownUsd; edges with proof), holderSupply (vaults per state: complete only when holders and totalSupply() agree at one block, partial, stale, unavailable), time (age known, proven lower bound, unknown; reclassified by data, activity or time), exits (complete exits, follow-up pending inside 72 hours, matched pairs, proven routes), topN (departures: below_monitored_threshold, never an exit by default).

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

monitoring.description: Without vault: holder-book lag, page errors, holders against supply, stale prices, top-N departures.

snapshot.description: snapshotId (the same on every tab and answer from one run), methodologyVersion, computedAt, holderSnapshotFrom/To, venueLiveFrom/To, pricingFrom/To, derivedAt, servedAt, build. Different ids are different runs, not a contradiction.

statements.description: methodologyVersion, definition, denominators, ageCoverage, historyReadBack (since 2026-11-25: the share of the placed value and positions whose depositors are read back to the vault’s deployment, by value and by count, with its time; quote it with the age share), noMatchingExit (window, followUpPending), exitCounts, agentLinked, size, spread, timeQuantities, states.

vault.description: With vault: the breakdown, says, ageCoverage, rank, holderBook. Null without vault.

vaults.description: Without vault: per vault the same breakdown with ageCoverage, rank and holderBook.
